{{Top}}
[[File:Bast_Castle.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Bast Castle]], to which Jedi Knights Jaden Korr and Kyle Katarn ventured.]]
{{Quote|I'm a water chemist by trade, and I've always wanted to study the famous acid rain. The kids are just coming along to, ah, play on the beach and so forth&hellip;|[[Jai Maruk]], commenting on Vjun's acid rain|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
'''Acid rain''' was caustic rainfall which was known to occur on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Kyle Katarn]] experienced acid rain on a [[Mission to Vjun (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|mission]] to [[Bast Castle]].<ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> Acid rain also fell in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> on the junk world of [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]],<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> and on a [[Unidentified planet (glass rain)|planet with glass rain]], the latter being severe enough to have the assassin droid [[AG-37]] suffer extreme damage from exposure.<ref name="Legacy 2 15">[[Legacy (2013) 15|''Legacy'' (2013) 15]]</ref>

Acid rain was a common phenomenon on [[Factory world/Legends|factory worlds]], specific planets with large manufacturing plants and industrial output, on which the environment was usually polluted enough for the rain to occur on a frequent basis.
